call_overview.title: About the call
call_overview.question: What does the call offer, and who can apply?

cards.title: What the call wants
cards.question: What is the principal thing the project must develop, and which problem or need must it address?
cards.answer: BMKB-Groen makes borrowing accessible for green equipment and business-premises improvements. Supported investments follow the referenced energy list or improve qualifying premises to at least energy label C.

cards.title: Project impact
cards.question: Which wider system outcomes and impacts must the project support?

cards.title: Who it suits
cards.question: Who may lead, which partners must take part, and how must the work be shared?
cards.answer:
Individual SMEs established and predominantly active in the Netherlands, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius or Saba can seek credit through an accredited financier.
- Size: At most 250 FTE and turnover up to EUR 50 million or a balance-sheet total up to EUR 43 million.
- Group assessment: Relevant associated enterprises count toward SME size.
- Excluded sectors: Finance, real estate and publicly insured healthcare; agricultural and fisheries restrictions also apply.
SMEs investing in eligible energy equipment could use this route when insufficient collateral obstructs otherwise viable borrowing. It could suit an SME deploying storage or electrifying its processes; eligibility depends on the specific investment. The borrowing enterprise needs a credible business outlook and a financier willing to provide credit.

call_overview.title: Relevance to TenneT
call_overview.question: Why is this call relevant to TenneT?

cards.title: Why it matters to TenneT
cards.question: Why does this call matter to TenneT, and why can't TenneT take part itself?
cards.answer: Supported storage and conversion equipment could expand third-party flexibility relevant to TenneT’s balancing and congestion work. This overlaps the interests illustrated by Lion Storage and DataFleX. TenneT cannot borrow under the SME route because large companies are excluded; the reviewed rules establish no alternative TenneT project role.

funding_timing_submission.title: Funding
funding_timing_submission.question: How much funding can the project receive?

cards.title: Funding envelope
cards.answer:
The maximum BMKB credit is EUR 1.5 million per enterprise.
- Funding form: Repayable credit supported by a state guarantee; the credit ceiling is not a total-project-budget ceiling.
cards.sources:
Borgstelling MKB-kredieten (BMKB) · Budget
Overzicht BMKB voorwaarden tm 30-06-2027 v1.0 · p. 1 · Omvang BMKB

cards.title: Funding rate and co-financing
cards.answer:
BMKB-Groen backs up to 75% of the loan; the state guarantee covers 90% of that portion.
- Co-financing conditions: The financier also provides credit outside the state-guaranteed portion, at least 33.3% of the BMKB credit.
cards.sources: Staatscourant 2022, 28713 · Toelichting, I. Algemeen, 2. Inhoud van de regeling

cards.title: Budget constraints
cards.answer:
BMKB-Groen limits the supporting expenditure included with eligible green assets.
- Caps or mandatory allocations: Inseparably connected items or activities outside the energy list may comprise at most 50% of the investment.
- Excluded costs: The building-improvement route excludes commercially rented real estate.
cards.sources: Staatscourant 2026, 23257 · Artikel I, onderdeel A, groene investering

cards.title: Cash flow and financial exposure
cards.answer:
The SME repays its borrowing and bears the guarantee fee.
- Payment model: Credit terms are agreed with the financier.
- Retention or guarantee: A one-off fee applies to BMKB credit: 2% for up to 24 quarters, or 3% for 25–48 quarters; the financier passes it on.

funding_timing_submission.title: Timing
funding_timing_submission.question: What timing should the proposal submission and project follow?

cards.title: Application route
cards.answer:
Apply through the financier, which registers the signed credit with RVO; the published closing windows need reconciliation.
- Stage 1 — Credit application: RVO gives 2027-07-01 as the scheme end; the 2026 amendment describes that year’s opening through 2026-12-31.
- Stage 2 — Registration: The financier notifies RVO after the credit offer is signed.
cards.sources:
BMKB-Groen · Aanvraagperiode
Aanvraaginformatie Borgstelling MKB-kredieten · opening text
Staatscourant 2026, 23257 · Toelichting, I. Algemeen, 1. Aanleiding

cards.title: Decision and contracting
cards.answer:
The financier decides whether to grant BMKB credit and negotiates the credit conditions.
- Conditions before starting: A signed credit offer precedes the financier’s notification to RVO.

funding_timing_submission.title: Application
funding_timing_submission.question: Mandatory information to include in the application

cards.title: Mandatory submission package — pass/fail
cards.answer:
The BMKB borrower must provide a signed de-minimis declaration covering the enterprise and its connected enterprises.
- Mandatory annexes: Provide an overview when several connected enterprises are involved.
- Partner documents: The declaration records prior de-minimis aid and other state aid for the same costs.
cards.sources:
Staatscourant 2026, 23257 · Artikel I, onderdelen G en H, artikel 5
Algemene de-minimisverklaring, versie 2025 · pp. 1–2 · Gegevens; Verklaring

cards.title: Evaluation and selection — scored or ranked
cards.answer:
The financier assesses the enterprise’s creditworthiness for BMKB credit.
- Evaluation criteria: Business continuity prospects, SME size, permitted sector, financing purpose and insufficient collateral determine whether the credit meets the published conditions.
cards.sources: Overzicht BMKB voorwaarden tm 30-06-2027 v1.0 · pp. 1–2 · Ondernemerscriteria; Financieringsdoel; Omvang BMKB; Ad 2

cards.title: Conditional and exceptional requirements
cards.answer:
BMKB-Groen financing does not automatically confer EIA tax relief.
- Conditional — EIA also sought: RVO assesses that application separately.
- Conditional — Further aid received before the award: Notify the granting authority immediately, as required by the de-minimis declaration.
